dialogue.context: Existing dialogue. Before asking for help finding the shuttle.

lines.speaker: Sella
lines.text: A net is mostly holes held in the right places. This one has ambitions.

description: Sella mends nets and teaches Pell to explain what holds a knot before accepting the work. Her missing wooden shuttle belonged to her brother, who lost two fingers to a winch and taught himself the work again. She resists turning his injury into an entertaining story for the ring crowd: he mostly called it inconvenient. Returning the shuttle earns his much-repaired scarf, which still does its work. Neither his current whereabouts nor his death is established.

data.description: Teaches him to undo and understand knots; his work must safely bear weight.

name: Sella
